---
title: "Demo: Loading Macros via `include-in-header`"
---

```{r}
#| label: embed-macros
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Embed macro definitions in a hidden div so MathJax processes them.
# This mirrors what include-in-header does for LaTeX/PDF output,
# but uses the document-body approach required for HTML/MathJax
# (which converts \providecommand to \def for MathJax v3 compatibility).
lines <- readLines("macros.qmd", warn = FALSE)
lines <- lines[!grepl("^\\s*<!--", lines) & nzchar(trimws(lines))]

# MathJax v3 does not support \providecommand; convert to \def.
lines <- vapply(lines, function(line) {
  m <- regmatches(
    line,
    regexec(
      "^\\\\providecommand\\{\\\\([^}]+)\\}(?:\\[(\\d+)\\])?\\{(.*)\\}\\s*$",
      line,
      perl = TRUE
    )
  )[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 4L && nzchar(m[1L])) {
    nargs    <- if (nzchar(m[3L])) as.integer(m[3L]) else 0L
    args_str <- if (nargs > 0L) paste0("#", seq_len(nargs), collapse = "") else ""
    return(paste0("\\def\\", m[2L], args_str, "{", m[4L], "}"))
  }
  line
}, character(1L), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

cat('::: {style="display:none"}\n$$\n')
cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
cat('$$\n:::\n')
```

This page demonstrates macros loaded via the `include-in-header` strategy. To use this strategy in your own Quarto project, add the following to `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
```

For a single document, you can instead specify `include-in-header` in the YAML front matter:

```yaml
---
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
---
```

This inserts `macros.qmd` verbatim into the document header. For LaTeX/PDF output, the macro definitions go into the preamble and are available throughout the document. For HTML output using MathJax, see the note on [`\providecommand` compatibility](index.qmd#via-the-quarto-include-shortcode).

## Example math

The table below shows examples of macros from `macros.qmd` rendered in this document.

| Description | Code | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Greek: alpha | `$\a$` | $\a$ |
| Greek: beta | `$\b$` | $\b$ |
| Greek: gamma | `$\g$` | $\g$ |
| Greek: lambda | `$\l$` | $\l$ |
| Greek: sigma | `$\s$` | $\s$ |
| Expected value | `$\E{X}$` | $\E{X}$ |
| Variance | `$\Var{X}$` | $\Var{X}$ |
| Standard deviation | `$\SD{X}$` | $\SD{X}$ |
| Standard error | `$\se{\hat\beta}$` | $\se{\hat\beta}$ |
| Normal distribution | `$\ndist{\mu, \sigma^2}$` | $\ndist{\mu, \sigma^2}$ |
| Log-likelihood | `$\llik$` | $\llik$ |
| Derivative | `$\deriv{\theta} \llik$` | $\deriv{\theta} \llik$ |
| Estimate | `$\est{\theta}$` | $\est{\theta}$ |
| Vector | `$\vc{x}$` | $\vc{x}$ |
| Absolute value | `$\abs{x}$` | $\abs{x}$ |
| Independent | `$X \ind Y$` | $X \ind Y$ |
